title: 留数与留数定理
summary: 留数是洛朗级数中 (z−z₀)⁻¹ 项的系数，也是围绕 z₀ 的简单闭曲线积分除以 2πi；留数定理把围道积分化为曲线内有限个孤立奇点留数之和。
summaryEn: The residue is the coefficient of (z−z₀)⁻¹ in the Laurent series; the residue theorem reduces a contour integral to a finite sum of residues at the isolated singularities inside the contour.
definition:
留数是复变函数在孤立奇点处的一个**局部数据**。设 $f$ 在 $z_0$ 的某个去心邻域内解析，$C$ 是该邻域内围绕 $z_0$ 的任意一条简单闭曲线（取正向），定义

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,z_0]=\frac{1}{2\pi i}\oint_C f(z)\,dz.$$

这个定义是合理的：在 $C$ 与更小的圆之间的环形区域上 $f$ 解析，由柯西积分定理，积分值与 $C$ 的大小、形状无关——只要曲线始终围绕 $z_0$ 且不碰到别的奇点。

留数还有等价而更本质的写法。在 $0<|z-z_0|<R$ 内，$f$ 可以展开为洛朗级数 $f(z)=\sum\limits_{n=-\infty}^{\infty}a_n(z-z_0)^n$；逐项积分时，由于 $\oint_C(z-z_0)^n dz$ 只有当 $n=-1$ 时等于 $2\pi i$、其余情形都是 $0$，于是得到

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,z_0]=a_{-1}.$$

也就是说，留数就是洛朗级数中 $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ 这一项的系数——它是展开式中唯一在回路积分下「存活」下来的项。

**留数定理**把这个局部量与整体积分联系起来：设 $f$ 在简单闭曲线 $C$ 及其内部除有限个孤立奇点 $z_1,\dots,z_n$ 外处处解析，$C$ 取正向，则

$$\oint_C f(z)\,dz=2\pi i\sum_{k=1}^{n}\operatorname{Res}[f,z_k].$$

它的价值在于「化整为零」：不必寻找原函数，也常常不必写出完整的洛朗级数，只要在每个奇点处做一次极限或求导，就能算出整条闭曲线上的积分。复变函数中一大批定积分（包括许多实积分）都由此变得可以计算。
definitionEn:
The residue is a **local datum** attached to an isolated singularity. Let $f$ be analytic in a punctured neighbourhood of $z_0$ and let $C$ be any positively oriented simple closed curve in that neighbourhood encircling $z_0$. One defines

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,z_0]=\frac{1}{2\pi i}\oint_C f(z)\,dz.$$

The definition is consistent: $f$ is analytic on the annulus between $C$ and a smaller circle, so by Cauchy's integral theorem the value is independent of the size and shape of $C$, as long as $C$ keeps encircling $z_0$ and encloses no other singularity.

There is an equivalent, more intrinsic description. On the annulus $0<|z-z_0|<R$ the function has a Laurent expansion $f(z)=\sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty}a_n(z-z_0)^n$, and integrating term by term — where $\oint_C(z-z_0)^n dz$ vanishes unless $n=-1$, giving $2\pi i$ — yields

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,z_0]=a_{-1}.$$

So the residue is exactly the coefficient of $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ in the Laurent series: the only term that survives contour integration.

The **residue theorem** globalises this local quantity. If $f$ is analytic on and inside a positively oriented simple closed curve $C$ except for finitely many isolated singularities $z_1,\dots,z_n$ inside, then

$$\oint_C f(z)\,dz=2\pi i\sum_{k=1}^{n}\operatorname{Res}[f,z_k].$$

Its power is economy: no antiderivative is needed, and often not even a full Laurent expansion — one limit or one derivative at each singularity determines an integral along the whole closed curve. A large class of definite integrals, real ones included, becomes computable this way.

formulas.note: 留数的定义：$C$ 是围绕 $z_0$ 的简单闭曲线（正向），积分值与 $C$ 的选取无关。
formulas.noteEn: Definition of a residue: $C$ is a positively oriented simple closed curve encircling $z_0$; the value does not depend on the choice of $C$.

formulas.note: 留数就是洛朗展开中 $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ 项的系数，这是最本质的刻画。
formulas.noteEn: The residue is the coefficient $a_{-1}$ of $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ in the Laurent expansion — the intrinsic characterisation.

formulas.note: 留数定理：$C$ 内只有有限个孤立奇点 $z_k$，$C$ 取正向，积分等于留数之和乘以 $2\pi i$。
formulas.noteEn: Residue theorem: with finitely many isolated singularities $z_k$ inside a positively oriented $C$, the integral is $2\pi i$ times the sum of the residues.

formulas.note: 无穷远点的留数；把所有奇点（含无穷远点）的留数加在一起等于 0（留数总和定理）。
formulas.noteEn: The residue at infinity; the residues at all singularities, infinity included, add up to zero.

formulas.note: 留数为 $a_{-1}$ 的根本原因：$n\ne -1$ 的项积分为 0，只有 $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ 项有贡献。
formulas.noteEn: Why the residue is $a_{-1}$: every power except $n=-1$ integrates to zero, so only $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ contributes.

expression.note: C 为围绕 z₀ 的简单闭曲线；留数等于洛朗系数 a₋₁，与 C 的大小形状无关。
expression.noteEn: C is a simple closed curve around z₀; the residue equals the Laurent coefficient a₋₁ and is independent of C.

properties: 留数是局部量：只由 $f$ 在 $z_0$ 附近的行为决定，与曲线 $C$ 的大小和形状无关。
可去奇点的留数为 0；更一般地，若洛朗展开中不含 $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ 项，该点留数就是 0。
留数定理要求 $C$ 内只有有限个孤立奇点、且 $f$ 在 $C$ 上解析；被积函数在曲线内部处处解析时积分自动为 0（柯西积分定理是它的特例）。
留数总和定理：$\sum_k \operatorname{Res}[f,z_k]+\operatorname{Res}[f,\infty]=0$，常用来求无穷远点的留数或检验计算。
留数定理是辐角原理、儒歇定理以及用留数计算实积分的基础工具。
propertiesEn: The residue is local: it depends only on the behaviour of $f$ near $z_0$, not on the size or shape of the curve $C$.
A removable singularity has residue 0; more generally the residue vanishes whenever the Laurent expansion has no $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ term.

The theorem requires finitely many isolated singularities inside $C$ and analyticity of $f$ on $C$; if $f$ is analytic throughout the interior the integral is 0, so Cauchy's integral theorem is the special case.
Sum of residues: counting infinity as well, $\sum_k \operatorname{Res}[f,z_k]+\operatorname{Res}[f,\infty]=0$ — useful for computing residues at infinity or checking work.
The residue theorem underlies the argument principle, Rouché's theorem and the evaluation of real integrals by residues.

examples.solution:
被积函数在 $|z|<2$ 内只有两个孤立奇点 $z=0$ 与 $z=1$，且都是一阶极点，可用极限公式求留数：

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,0]=\lim_{z\to0}z\cdot\frac{e^z}{z(z-1)}=\frac{e^0}{0-1}=-1,$$$$\operatorname{Res}[f,1]=\lim_{z\to1}(z-1)\cdot\frac{e^z}{z(z-1)}=\frac{e}{1}=e.$$两个奇点都在圆周内部，由留数定理

$$\oint_{|z|=2}\frac{e^z}{z(z-1)}\,dz=2\pi i\bigl(-1+e\bigr)=2\pi i(e-1).$$

examples.problem: 若把上题的圆周缩小为 $|z|=\frac12$，积分等于多少？
examples.solution:
这时只有 $z=0$ 落在圆周内部（$z=1$ 在圆外，其留数不再计入）。由留数定理

$$\oint_{|z|=1/2}\frac{e^z}{z(z-1)}\,dz=2\pi i\cdot\operatorname{Res}[f,0]=2\pi i\cdot(-1)=-2\pi i.$$这正说明围道积分只「看见」曲线内部的奇点。

title: 留数的计算
summary: 不展开洛朗级数也能算留数：一阶极点用 lim(z−z₀)f(z) 或有理函数的 P(z₀)/Q′(z₀)，m 阶极点用 (m−1) 阶导数的极限公式，可去奇点为 0，无穷远点用带负号的变换公式。
summaryEn: Residues without Laurent expansions: a simple pole uses lim(z−z₀)f(z) or P(z₀)/Q′(z₀) for rational functions, an m-th order pole uses a derivative limit, removable singularities give 0, and infinity has its own sign-carrying formula.
definition:
设 $z_0$ 是 $f$ 的一阶极点。把 $f$ 写成 $f(z)=\frac{a_{-1}}{z-z_0}+a_0+a_1(z-z_0)+\cdots$，两边乘 $(z-z_0)$ 再令 $z\to z_0$，就得到最常用的公式

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,z_0]=\lim_{z\to z_0}(z-z_0)f(z).$$

当 $f=\frac{P}{Q}$ 是有理函数且 $P(z_0)\ne0$、$Q(z_0)=0$、$Q'(z_0)\ne0$ 时，$z_0$ 必是一阶极点，代入上式并利用 $Q(z_0)=0$ 可得更省力的版本

$$\operatorname{Res}\left[\frac{P}{Q},z_0\right]=\frac{P(z_0)}{Q'(z_0)}.$$

若 $z_0$ 是 $f$ 的 $m$ 阶极点，则 $(z-z_0)^m f(z)$ 在 $z_0$ 处解析，比较洛朗系数可得求导公式

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,z_0]=\frac{1}{(m-1)!}\lim_{z\to z_0}\frac{d^{m-1}}{dz^{m-1}}\left[(z-z_0)^m f(z)\right].$$

$m=1$ 时它退化为上面的极限公式（$0!=1$）。阶数越高，求导越麻烦，这时直接做洛朗展开往往更快。

有两类奇点不必费力计算：**可去奇点**的留数为 $0$（洛朗展开没有负幂项，当然也没有 $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ 项）；本质奇点则只能靠展开取系数，例如 $e^{1/z}=1+\frac1z+\frac{1}{2!z^2}+\cdots$ 在 $z=0$ 处的留数为 $1$。

在扩充复平面上还定义**无穷远点的留数**：

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,\infty]=-\operatorname{Res}\left[\frac{1}{z^2}f\!\left(\frac{1}{z}\right),0\right],$$

负号的来源是要让「所有奇点（含无穷远点）的留数之和为 $0$」这条守恒律成立：它把扩充复平面上零散的计算拼成一幅完整的图景。
definitionEn:
Let $z_0$ be a simple pole of $f$. Writing $f(z)=\frac{a_{-1}}{z-z_0}+a_0+a_1(z-z_0)+\cdots$ and multiplying by $(z-z_0)$ before letting $z\to z_0$ gives the standard formula

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,z_0]=\lim_{z\to z_0}(z-z_0)f(z).$$

If $f=\frac{P}{Q}$ is rational with $P(z_0)\ne0$, $Q(z_0)=0$ and $Q'(z_0)\ne0$, then $z_0$ is a simple pole and the same limit simplifies to

$$\operatorname{Res}\left[\frac{P}{Q},z_0\right]=\frac{P(z_0)}{Q'(z_0)}.$$

An $m$-th order pole is handled by the derivative formula, obtained by comparing Laurent coefficients for the analytic function $(z-z_0)^m f(z)$:

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,z_0]=\frac{1}{(m-1)!}\lim_{z\to z_0}\frac{d^{m-1}}{dz^{m-1}}\left[(z-z_0)^m f(z)\right].$$

For $m=1$ it degenerates to the limit formula ($0!=1$). The higher the order, the costlier the differentiation — a Laurent expansion is then often faster.

Two cases are free: a **removable singularity** has residue $0$ (no negative powers, hence no $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ term), while an essential singularity must be expanded, e.g. $e^{1/z}=1+\frac1z+\frac{1}{2!z^2}+\cdots$ has residue $1$ at $z=0$.

On the extended plane one also defines the **residue at infinity**,

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,\infty]=-\operatorname{Res}\left[\frac{1}{z^2}f\!\left(\frac{1}{z}\right),0\right],$$

the sign being chosen so that the residues at all singularities, infinity included, sum to $0$.

formulas.note: 一阶极点的留数：乘 $(z-z_0)$ 后取极限。
formulas.noteEn: Residue at a simple pole: multiply by $(z-z_0)$ and take the limit.

formulas.note: 有理函数的一阶极点（$P(z_0)\ne0$，$Q(z_0)=0$，$Q'(z_0)\ne0$），直接代入，免去求极限。
formulas.noteEn: A simple pole of a rational function ($P(z_0)\ne0$, $Q(z_0)=0$, $Q'(z_0)\ne0$): substitute directly, no limit needed.

formulas.note: $m$ 阶极点的留数：对 $(z-z_0)^m f(z)$ 求 $m-1$ 阶导数后取极限。
formulas.noteEn: Residue at an $m$-th order pole: differentiate $(z-z_0)^m f(z)$ $m-1$ times, then take the limit.

formulas.note: 可去奇点的留数恒为 0，遇到它直接跳过。
formulas.noteEn: A removable singularity always has residue 0 — skip it.

formulas.note: 无穷远点的留数公式；负号保证所有留数（含 $\infty$）之和为 0。
formulas.noteEn: The residue at infinity; the minus sign makes all residues, infinity included, sum to zero.

expression.note: 一阶极点的标准公式；$m$ 阶极点改用 $\frac{1}{(m-1)!}\lim\frac{d^{m-1}}{dz^{m-1}}[(z-z_0)^m f(z)]$。
expression.noteEn: The standard formula for a simple pole; for an $m$-th order pole use the $(m-1)$-st derivative limit instead.

properties: 先判断奇点类型再选公式：可去奇点写 0；一阶极点用极限（有理函数可直接用 $P(z_0)/Q'(z_0)$）；$m$ 阶极点用求导公式。
求导公式里的阶数由「极点阶数 $m$」决定：$m=1$ 时是 0 阶导，即回到极限公式。
若洛朗展开已知，直接读 $(z-z_0)^{-1}$ 的系数最省事；本质奇点只有这一条路可走。
对 $f=\frac{g(z)}{(z-z_0)^m}$（$g$ 在 $z_0$ 解析），留数等于 $g$ 在 $z_0$ 的泰勒展开中 $(z-z_0)^{m-1}$ 项的系数，这与求导公式等价。
无穷远点留数带负号：$\operatorname{Res}[f,\infty]=-\operatorname{Res}[z^{-2}f(1/z),0]$；所有奇点留数之和（含 $\infty$）为 0，可用来验算。
propertiesEn: Classify the singularity first: removable → 0; simple pole → the limit formula (or $P(z_0)/Q'(z_0)$ for rational functions); $m$-th order pole → the derivative formula.
The order of the derivative is fixed by the pole order: for $m=1$ it is the zeroth derivative, i.e. the plain limit formula.
If the Laurent expansion is available, just read off the coefficient of $(z-z_0)^{-1}$; for an essential singularity there is no alternative.
For $f=\frac{g(z)}{(z-z_0)^m}$ with $g$ analytic, the residue is the coefficient of $(z-z_0)^{m-1}$ in the Taylor expansion of $g$ — equivalent to the derivative formula.
The residue at infinity carries a minus sign: $\operatorname{Res}[f,\infty]=-\operatorname{Res}[z^{-2}f(1/z),0]$; the sum of all residues including infinity is 0, a useful check.

examples.problem: 求 $f(z)=\frac{e^z}{z^2(z-1)}$ 在 $z=0$ 与 $z=1$ 处的留数，并计算 $\oint_{|z|=2}f(z)\,dz$。
examples.solution:
$z=1$ 是一阶极点，用极限公式：

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,1]=\lim_{z\to1}(z-1)\frac{e^z}{z^2(z-1)}=\frac{e}{1^2}=e.$$

$z=0$ 是二阶极点（分母含因子 $z^2$），用 $m=2$ 的求导公式：

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,0]=\frac{1}{1!}\lim_{z\to0}\frac{d}{dz}\left[z^2\cdot\frac{e^z}{z^2(z-1)}\right]=\lim_{z\to0}\frac{d}{dz}\frac{e^z}{z-1}.$$

而 $\frac{d}{dz}\frac{e^z}{z-1}=\frac{e^z(z-1)-e^z}{(z-1)^2}=\frac{e^z(z-2)}{(z-1)^2}$，代入 $z=0$ 得 $-2$，故 $\operatorname{Res}[f,0]=-2$。

两个奇点都在 $|z|=2$ 内，由留数定理

$$\oint_{|z|=2}\frac{e^z}{z^2(z-1)}\,dz=2\pi i\bigl(e-2\bigr).$$

examples.problem: 求 $f(z)=\frac{z}{z^2+1}$ 在无穷远点的留数，并用留数总和定理验证。
examples.solution:
按公式先化简 $\frac{1}{z^2}f\!\left(\frac1z\right)$：

$$\frac{1}{z^2}\cdot\frac{1/z}{1/z^2+1}=\frac{1}{z(1+z^2)}.$$

它在 $z=0$ 处是一阶极点，留数为 $\lim_{z\to0}z\cdot\frac{1}{z(1+z^2)}=1$，因此

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,\infty]=-1.$$

验证：$f=\frac{z}{(z-i)(z+i)}$ 的两个有限奇点是 $\pm i$，且

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,i]=\frac{i}{2i}=\frac12,\qquad \operatorname{Res}[f,-i]=\frac{-i}{-2i}=\frac12,$$

有限留数之和为 $1$，加上 $\operatorname{Res}[f,\infty]=-1$ 恰好为 $0$，与留数总和定理一致。

title: 用留数计算实积分
summary: 三类经典实积分——有理函数的无穷积分、含 e^{imx} 的振荡积分、三角有理式的整周期积分——都可以化为合适的围道积分，其值等于围道内留数之和乘以 2πi。
summaryEn: Three classical families of real integrals — rational functions over the line, oscillatory integrals with e^{imx}, and trigonometric rational functions over a period — all reduce to contour integrals whose values are 2πi times the enclosed residues.
definition:
**第一类：有理函数的无穷积分。** 设 $P,Q$ 是多项式，$\deg Q\ge\deg P+2$，且 $Q$ 没有实零点。取上半平面的大半圆围道 $C_R$（半径 $R$ 的半圆弧加上 $[-R,R]$ 这段实轴）。当 $R\to\infty$ 时被积函数在圆弧上的模是 $O(R^{-2})$，而弧长只有 $\pi R$，圆弧上的积分趋于 $0$，于是

$$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\,dx=2\pi i\sum_{\operatorname{Im}z_k>0}\operatorname{Res}\left[\frac{P}{Q},z_k\right].$$

**第二类：带 $e^{imx}$ 的振荡积分（$m>0$）。** 把 $e^{imx}$ 换成 $e^{imz}$，仍取上半平面大半圆围道。由于 $|e^{imz}|=e^{-m\operatorname{Im}z}\le1$ 且沿圆弧指数衰减（Jordan 引理），圆弧上的积分仍趋于 $0$，所以

$$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(x)e^{imx}\,dx=2\pi i\sum_{\operatorname{Im}z_k>0}\operatorname{Res}\left[f(z)e^{imz},z_k\right].$$

要算 $\int f(x)\cos mx\,dx$ 或 $\int f(x)\sin mx\,dx$，先算出上式再取实部或虚部即可；此时对 $f$ 的衰减要求可以放宽到 $\deg Q\ge\deg P+1$。

**第三类：三角有理式的整周期积分。** 对 $\int_0^{2\pi}R(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)\,d\theta$，令 $z=e^{i\theta}$，则

$$\cos\theta=\frac{z+z^{-1}}{2},\qquad \sin\theta=\frac{z-z^{-1}}{2i},\qquad d\theta=\frac{dz}{iz},$$

并且 $\theta$ 从 $0$ 增到 $2\pi$ 时 $z$ 恰好沿单位圆 $|z|=1$ 正向转一圈，于是

$$\int_0^{2\pi}R(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)\,d\theta=\oint_{|z|=1}R\!\left(\frac{z+z^{-1}}{2},\frac{z-z^{-1}}{2i}\right)\frac{dz}{iz}=2\pi i\sum_{|z_k|<1}\operatorname{Res}.$$

三条公式都依赖「围道上的积分趋于 0」这一估计：次数条件、$Q$ 无实零点、$m>0$ 都是为它服务的。若 $Q$ 在实轴上有单零点，可让围道用小半圆从上方绕过该点，积分按柯西主值理解，此时主值等于 $2\pi i\sum_{\operatorname{Im}>0}\operatorname{Res}+\pi i\sum_{\text{实轴单极点}}\operatorname{Res}$。
definitionEn:
**Type 1: rational functions over the whole line.** Let $P,Q$ be polynomials with $\deg Q\ge\deg P+2$ and $Q$ free of real zeros. Take the large semicircular contour $C_R$ in the upper half-plane (the arc plus the segment $[-R,R]$). As $R\to\infty$ the integrand on the arc is $O(R^{-2})$ while the arc has length $\pi R$, so the arc contributes $0$ and

$$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\,dx=2\pi i\sum_{\operatorname{Im}z_k>0}\operatorname{Res}\left[\frac{P}{Q},z_k\right].$$

**Type 2: oscillatory integrals with $e^{imx}$ ($m>0$).** Replace $e^{imx}$ by $e^{imz}$ and use the same semicircle. Since $|e^{imz}|=e^{-m\operatorname{Im}z}\le1$ decays exponentially along the arc (Jordan's lemma), the arc still contributes nothing:

$$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(x)e^{imx}\,dx=2\pi i\sum_{\operatorname{Im}z_k>0}\operatorname{Res}\left[f(z)e^{imz},z_k\right].$$

To evaluate $\int f(x)\cos mx\,dx$ or $\int f(x)\sin mx\,dx$, compute the integral above and take real or imaginary parts; the decay requirement on $f$ relaxes to $\deg Q\ge\deg P+1$.

**Type 3: trigonometric rational functions.** For $\int_0^{2\pi}R(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)\,d\theta$ put $z=e^{i\theta}$:

$$\cos\theta=\frac{z+z^{-1}}{2},\qquad \sin\theta=\frac{z-z^{-1}}{2i},\qquad d\theta=\frac{dz}{iz},$$

and as $\theta$ runs from $0$ to $2\pi$, $z$ traverses the unit circle $|z|=1$ once in the positive direction, so

$$\int_0^{2\pi}R(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)\,d\theta=\oint_{|z|=1}R\!\left(\frac{z+z^{-1}}{2},\frac{z-z^{-1}}{2i}\right)\frac{dz}{iz}=2\pi i\sum_{|z_k|<1}\operatorname{Res}.$$

All three formulas rely on the estimate that the contour integral over the arc vanishes; the degree conditions, the absence of real zeros and the sign of $m$ serve exactly this purpose. If $Q$ has simple zeros on the real axis, indent the contour above them and interpret the integral as a Cauchy principal value.

formulas.note: 第一类：要求 $\deg Q\ge\deg P+2$ 且 $Q$ 无实零点；围道取上半平面大半圆。
formulas.noteEn: Type 1: requires $\deg Q\ge\deg P+2$ and no real zeros of $Q$; the contour is a large semicircle in the upper half-plane.

formulas.note: 第二类：$m>0$ 时 $e^{imz}$ 在上半平面指数衰减（Jordan 引理）；取实部或虚部即得 $\cos mx$、$\sin mx$ 型积分。
formulas.noteEn: Type 2: for $m>0$, $e^{imz}$ decays exponentially in the upper half-plane (Jordan's lemma); real and imaginary parts give the $\cos mx$ and $\sin mx$ integrals.

formulas.note: 第三类：令 $z=e^{i\theta}$，$\cos\theta=\frac{z+z^{-1}}{2}$，$\sin\theta=\frac{z-z^{-1}}{2i}$，$d\theta=\frac{dz}{iz}$。
formulas.noteEn: Type 3: substitute $z=e^{i\theta}$, $\cos\theta=\frac{z+z^{-1}}{2}$, $\sin\theta=\frac{z-z^{-1}}{2i}$, $d\theta=\frac{dz}{iz}$.

formulas.note: 经典结果；取实部得 $\int\frac{\cos mx}{1+x^2}dx=\pi e^{-m}$。
formulas.noteEn: A classic result; its real part gives $\int\frac{\cos mx}{1+x^2}dx=\pi e^{-m}$.

formulas.note: 由第三类方法导出（$a>|b|$ 保证分母在单位圆上无零点，圆内恰有一个极点）。
formulas.noteEn: Obtained by the Type 3 method ($a>|b|$ keeps the denominator non-zero on the unit circle; exactly one pole lies inside).

expression.text: ∫_{−∞}^{∞} P(x)/Q(x) dx = 2πi Σ_{Im z_k > 0} Res[P/Q, z_k]
expression.note: 围道取上半平面大半圆，只用上半平面的留数；三角有理式则化到单位圆内取留数。
expression.noteEn: With a large semicircular contour only upper half-plane residues enter; trigonometric rational functions reduce to residues inside the unit circle.

properties: 第一类要求 $\deg Q\ge\deg P+2$；第二类可放宽为 $\deg Q\ge\deg P+1$，因为 $e^{imz}$ 在上半平面指数衰减（Jordan 引理）。
围道取在上半平面是因为 $m>0$ 时 $e^{imz}$ 在那里衰减；若 $m<0$ 应改取下半平面，并注意围道方向带来的符号。
三角有理式化归单位圆后只保留 $|z|<1$ 内的留数；若极点恰好落在单位圆上，原积分发散。
算 $\cos mx$、$\sin mx$ 型积分时，先算复指数 $e^{imx}$ 的积分再取实部或虚部，通常比直接处理三角函数简单。
实轴上有单极点时用小半圆绕开，得到柯西主值：$\mathrm{PV}=2\pi i\sum_{\operatorname{Im}>0}\operatorname{Res}+\pi i\sum_{\text{实轴单极点}}\operatorname{Res}$（奇点从上方绕过）。
propertiesEn: Type 1 needs $\deg Q\ge\deg P+2$; Type 2 relaxes this to $\deg Q\ge\deg P+1$, because $e^{imz}$ decays exponentially in the upper half-plane (Jordan's lemma).
The contour is placed in the upper half-plane because $e^{imz}$ decays there when $m>0$; for $m<0$ one uses the lower half-plane and tracks the orientation sign.
After the unit-circle substitution only residues with $|z|<1$ survive; a pole on the unit circle signals a divergent integral.
For $\cos mx$ and $\sin mx$ integrals, first compute the complex-exponential integral and then take real or imaginary parts — usually simpler than handling the trigonometric factor directly.

With simple real poles one indents the contour and obtains the Cauchy principal value $\mathrm{PV}=2\pi i\sum_{\operatorname{Im}>0}\operatorname{Res}+\pi i\sum_{\text{simple real poles}}\operatorname{Res}$ (indenting above each pole).

plot.title: ∫dx/(1+x²) 的留数算法：上半平面只有极点 z = i

examples.solution:
(1) 取 $f(z)=\frac{1}{1+z^2}=\frac{1}{(z-i)(z+i)}$。分子次数 0、分母次数 2，满足 $\deg Q\ge\deg P+2$，且 $1+x^2$ 无实零点。上半平面内只有一个一阶极点 $z=i$：

$$\operatorname{Res}[f,i]=\lim_{z\to i}(z-i)\frac{1}{(z-i)(z+i)}=\frac{1}{2i}.$$

于是 $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{dx}{1+x^2}=2\pi i\cdot\frac{1}{2i}=\pi$。

(2) 考虑 $g(z)=\frac{e^{imz}}{1+z^2}$，取上半平面大半圆围道，圆弧上的积分趋于 0。上半平面内只有一阶极点 $z=i$：

$$\operatorname{Res}[g,i]=\frac{e^{im\cdot i}}{2i}=\frac{e^{-m}}{2i}.$$

因此 $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{imx}}{1+x^2}dx=2\pi i\cdot\frac{e^{-m}}{2i}=\pi e^{-m}$；取实部即得

$$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{\cos(mx)}{1+x^2}\,dx=\pi e^{-m}.$$

（虚部对应 $\int\frac{\sin(mx)}{1+x^2}dx$，因被积函数是奇函数而为 0，与此一致。）

令 $z=e^{i\theta}$，则 $\cos\theta=\frac{z+z^{-1}}{2}$，$d\theta=\frac{dz}{iz}$。

$$2+\cos\theta=2+\frac{z+z^{-1}}{2}=\frac{z^2+4z+1}{2z},$$

所以

$$\int_0^{2\pi}\frac{d\theta}{2+\cos\theta}=\oint_{|z|=1}\frac{dz}{iz}\cdot\frac{2z}{z^2+4z+1}=\frac{2}{i}\oint_{|z|=1}\frac{dz}{z^2+4z+1}.$$

分母的零点是 $z=-2\pm\sqrt3$；只有 $z_0=-2+\sqrt3$ 在单位圆内（$|z_0|\approx0.268$）。它是一阶极点，留数为

$$\operatorname{Res}\left[\frac{1}{z^2+4z+1},z_0\right]=\frac{1}{2z_0+4}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt3}.$$

于是原积分 $=\frac{2}{i}\cdot 2\pi i\cdot\frac{1}{2\sqrt3}=\frac{2\pi}{\sqrt3}$。

title: 辐角原理与儒歇定理
summary: 辐角原理用 ∮_C f′(z)/f(z) dz = 2πi(N−P) 数出围道内零点与极点个数之差；儒歇定理则通过边界上 |g|<|f| 的「比大小」判断 f 与 f+g 的零点个数。
summaryEn: The argument principle counts zeros minus poles inside a contour via ∮_C f′(z)/f(z) dz = 2πi(N−P); Rouché's theorem compares |g| with |f| on the boundary to show that f and f+g have the same number of zeros inside.
definition:
**辐角原理**回答一个计数问题：一条闭曲线内部有多少个零点、多少个极点？设 $f$ 在简单闭曲线 $C$ 及其内部除有限个极点外解析（$C$ 上没有零点也没有极点），$C$ 取正向，则

$$\frac{1}{2\pi i}\oint_C\frac{f'(z)}{f(z)}\,dz=N-P,$$

其中 $N$ 是 $C$ 内零点的个数，$P$ 是极点的个数，都按**重数**计算（例如二重零点算 2 个）。

道理来自留数：在 $m$ 重零点 $z_0$ 附近 $f(z)=(z-z_0)^m g(z)$ 且 $g(z_0)\ne0$，于是 $\frac{f'}{f}=\frac{m}{z-z_0}+\frac{g'}{g}$，它在 $z_0$ 的留数是 $m$；在 $k$ 阶极点附近 $f=\frac{h(z)}{(z-z_0)^k}$，类似地 $\frac{f'}{f}=-\frac{k}{z-z_0}+\frac{h'}{h}$，留数是 $-k$。把所有留数加起来用留数定理，就得到 $N-P$。左端也等于 $f$ 沿 $C$ 的辐角总变化除以 $2\pi$，即像曲线 $f(C)$ 绕原点的圈数，「辐角原理」由此得名。

**儒歇定理**把「数零点」变成「比大小」：设 $f,g$ 在 $C$ 及其内部解析且 $f$ 在 $C$ 上无零点，如果在 $C$ 上处处有

$$|g(z)|<|f(z)|,$$

那么 $f$ 与 $f+g$ 在 $C$ 内部有相同个数的零点（按重数计）。证明思路：令 $f_t=f+tg$（$0\le t\le1$）。由严格不等式，每个 $f_t$ 在 $C$ 上都没有零点，零点个数随 $t$ 连续变化，又只能取整数值，于是恒为常数，特别地 $f_0=f$ 与 $f_1=f+g$ 的零点个数相同。

经典应用是**代数基本定理**：$n$ 次多项式 $z^n+a_{n-1}z^{n-1}+\cdots+a_0$ 在复平面上恰好有 $n$ 个零点（按重数计）。取 $f(z)=z^n$、$g(z)=a_{n-1}z^{n-1}+\cdots+a_0$，在半径 $R$ 足够大的圆周上 $|g|<|f|$，而 $z^n$ 在圆内以 $0$ 为 $n$ 重零点，故原多项式也有 $n$ 个零点。
definitionEn:
The **argument principle** answers a counting question: how many zeros and how many poles lie inside a closed curve? Let $f$ be analytic on and inside a positively oriented simple closed curve $C$ except for finitely many poles (with no zeros or poles on $C$ itself). Then

$$\frac{1}{2\pi i}\oint_C\frac{f'(z)}{f(z)}\,dz=N-P,$$

where $N$ counts the zeros and $P$ the poles inside $C$, multiplicities included (a double zero counts twice).

The reason is a residue computation: near a zero of multiplicity $m$, $f=(z-z_0)^m g$ with $g(z_0)\ne0$, so $\frac{f'}{f}=\frac{m}{z-z_0}+\frac{g'}{g}$ has residue $m$ there; near a pole of order $k$, $f=\frac{h}{(z-z_0)^k}$ and $\frac{f'}{f}=-\frac{k}{z-z_0}+\frac{h'}{h}$ has residue $-k$. Summing all residues with the residue theorem yields $N-P$. Equivalently the left side equals $(2\pi)^{-1}$ times the total change of $\arg f$ along $C$, i.e. the winding number of the image curve $f(C)$ about the origin — whence the name.

**Rouché's theorem** replaces counting by comparison: if $f,g$ are analytic on and inside $C$, $f$ has no zero on $C$, and everywhere on $C$

$$|g(z)|<|f(z)|,$$

then $f$ and $f+g$ have the same number of zeros inside $C$ (with multiplicity). Proof idea: set $f_t=f+tg$ for $0\le t\le1$. The strict inequality keeps every $f_t$ zero-free on $C$, so the zero count varies continuously with $t$ while taking only integer values — hence it is constant, and $f_0=f$, $f_1=f+g$ agree.

The classical application is the **fundamental theorem of algebra**: a polynomial $z^n+a_{n-1}z^{n-1}+\cdots+a_0$ has exactly $n$ zeros in the complex plane, counted with multiplicity. Take $f(z)=z^n$ and $g(z)=a_{n-1}z^{n-1}+\cdots+a_0$; on a circle of sufficiently large radius $R$ one has $|g|<|f|$, and $z^n$ has the $n$-fold zero $0$ inside, so the polynomial has $n$ zeros as well.

formulas.note: 辐角原理：$N$、$P$ 分别为 $C$ 内零点、极点的个数（按重数计），$f$ 在 $C$ 上无零点也无极点。
formulas.noteEn: Argument principle: $N$ and $P$ count zeros and poles inside $C$ with multiplicity; $f$ has neither on $C$.

formulas.note: 辐角形式：$f(z)$ 沿 $C$ 绕行一周时辐角的总变化除以 $2\pi$，等于像曲线绕原点的圈数。
formulas.noteEn: Angular form: the total change of $\arg f$ along $C$, divided by $2\pi$, is the winding number of the image curve about the origin.

formulas.note: $z_0$ 为 $m$ 重零点、$p_0$ 为 $k$ 阶极点时 $f'/f$ 的留数；这就是辐角原理的来源。
formulas.noteEn: Residues of $f'/f$ at an $m$-fold zero and at a $k$-th order pole; this is the source of the argument principle.

formulas.latex: |g(z)|<|f(z)|\ (z\in C)\ \Longrightarrow\ f\ \text{与}\ f+g\ \text{在}\ C\ \text{内零点个数相同}
formulas.note: 儒歇定理：严格不等式必须对整条 $C$ 成立，零点个数按重数计。
formulas.noteEn: Rouché's theorem: the strict inequality must hold on the whole of $C$; zeros are counted with multiplicity.

formulas.note: 代数基本定理：$n$ 次多项式在 $\mathbb C$ 上恰有 $n$ 个零点（按重数计），是儒歇定理的经典应用。
formulas.noteEn: Fundamental theorem of algebra: a degree-$n$ polynomial has exactly $n$ complex zeros counted with multiplicity — a classical Rouché application.

expression.text: (1/2πi)∮_C f′(z)/f(z) dz = N − P（按重数计）
expression.note: 用积分器数零点与极点：$f'/f$ 在每个零点、极点处的留数分别是重数与负阶数。
expression.noteEn: Counting zeros and poles by an integral: the residues of $f'/f$ are the multiplicities (positive at zeros, negative at poles).

properties: $N$、$P$ 都按重数计：二重零点贡献 2，三阶极点贡献 3。
$f'/f$ 在 $m$ 重零点处的留数是 $m$，在 $k$ 阶极点处的留数是 $-k$，这正是辐角原理的来源。
$C$ 上不能有 $f$ 的零点或极点，否则 $f'/f$ 在围道上有奇点；实际应用中可先用小弧绕开。
儒歇定理的严格不等式 $|g|<|f|$ 必须在整条 $C$ 上成立；结论是 $f$ 与 $f+g$ 在 $C$ 内零点个数相同（按重数计）。
典型用法：把一个多项式写成「主项 + 小项」，在合适圆周上比较大小即可数出零点；代数基本定理与零点定位都由此而来。
propertiesEn: $N$ and $P$ count with multiplicity: a double zero contributes 2 and a third-order pole contributes 3.
$f'/f$ has residue $m$ at an $m$-fold zero and residue $-k$ at a $k$-th order pole — the mechanism behind the argument principle.
$f$ must have neither zeros nor poles on $C$, otherwise $f'/f$ is singular on the contour; in practice one detours with small arcs.
The strict bound $|g|<|f|$ of Rouché's theorem must hold on all of $C$; the conclusion is that $f$ and $f+g$ have equally many zeros inside $C$, counted with multiplicity.
Typical use: split a polynomial into a dominant part plus a small part and compare sizes on a suitable circle — this yields the fundamental theorem of algebra and locates zeros.

plot.title: 辐角原理：∮_C f′(z)/f(z) dz = 2πi(N − P)

examples.problem: 用儒歇定理证明 $z^5+3z+1$ 在 $|z|<1$ 内恰有一个零点。

examples.solution:
先数奇点：零点为 $z=0$（二重）与 $z=1$（一重），都在 $|z|<2$ 内，故 $N=2+1=3$；极点为 $z=-3$，在 $|z|=2$ 外，故 $P=0$。且 $|z|=2$ 上没有零点与极点。

由辐角原理

$$\oint_{|z|=2}\frac{f'(z)}{f(z)}\,dz=2\pi i\,(N-P)=2\pi i\cdot 3=6\pi i.$$

（直接验证：$\frac{f'}{f}=\frac{2}{z}+\frac{1}{z-1}-\frac{1}{z+3}$，其中 $-3$ 在圆外，只有前两项贡献留数 $2+1=3$。）

title: 卷积
summary: 卷积按「翻转—平移—相乘—积分」把两个函数合成一个新函数，满足交换律、结合律、分配律；它与傅里叶、拉普拉斯变换互相配合：时域卷积等于频域相乘。
summaryEn: Convolution combines two functions by flip, shift, multiply and integrate; it is commutative, associative and distributive, and it exchanges with the Fourier and Laplace transforms — convolution in time becomes multiplication in frequency.
definition:
卷积是函数之间的一种「混合」运算。函数 $f$ 与 $g$ 的卷积定义为

$$(f*g)(t)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(\tau)g(t-\tau)\,d\tau.$$

只要积分存在（例如 $f,g$ 都绝对可积，或一个有界、另一个有紧支撑），卷积就有意义；积分变量 $\tau$ 是「哑变量」，结果只依赖于平移量 $t$。

直观上，把 $g(t-\tau)$ 看成 $g(\tau)$ 关于纵轴翻转后再平移 $t$，卷积就是两条曲线重叠部分的「带符号面积」。例如两个宽度为 1 的单位矩形脉冲（方波）卷积得到一个三角形；宽度不同的两个矩形脉冲卷积得到梯形，支撑区间的长度等于两者宽度之和。也可以把卷积理解为以 $g$ 为核的**加权平均**：$f$ 被 $g$ 平滑，若 $g$ 是集中在一点附近的窄峰，则 $f*g$ 近似于 $f$ 的平移。

卷积满足**交换律** $f*g=g*f$、**结合律** $(f*g)*h=f*(g*h)$、**分配律** $f*(g+h)=f*g+f*h$；在适当条件下求导可以落在任意一个因子上：$(f*g)'=f'*g=f*g'$。于是函数空间在卷积下成为一个交换结合代数。

**卷积定理**是卷积在应用数学中无处不在的原因：对傅里叶变换

$$\mathcal{F}[f*g](\omega)=F(\omega)G(\omega),$$

时域的卷积对应频域的普通乘法（拉普拉斯变换也有同样的性质）。求解线性系统的输出 $y=h*x$（$h$ 是冲激响应）时，直接计算卷积往往很麻烦，而作变换后只需相乘或相除，再逆变换回去即可。
definitionEn:
Convolution is a way of blending two functions. The convolution of $f$ and $g$ is defined by

$$(f*g)(t)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(\tau)g(t-\tau)\,d\tau.$$

Whenever the integral converges (for instance when both functions are absolutely integrable, or one is bounded and the other compactly supported) the convolution is well defined; the integration variable $\tau$ is a dummy variable and only the shift $t$ matters.

Picture $g(t-\tau)$ as $g(\tau)$ reflected in the vertical axis and then shifted by $t$: the convolution is the signed area of the overlap of the two graphs. Two unit rectangular pulses of width 1 convolve to a triangle, while pulses of different widths give a trapezoid whose support is the sum of the two widths. Equivalently, convolution is a weighted average of $f$ with kernel $g$: $f$ is smoothed by $g$, and when $g$ is a narrow peak the result is approximately a shift of $f$.

Convolution is **commutative** ($f*g=g*f$), **associative** ($(f*g)*h=f*(g*h)$) and **distributive** ($f*(g+h)=f*g+f*h$); under suitable hypotheses differentiation can be put on either factor, $(f*g)'=f'*g=f*g'$. Function spaces therefore form a commutative algebra under convolution.

The **convolution theorem** explains the ubiquity of convolution in applied mathematics. For the Fourier transform,

$$\mathcal{F}[f*g](\omega)=F(\omega)G(\omega),$$

convolution in time becomes ordinary multiplication in frequency (the Laplace transform obeys the same rule). To obtain the output $y=h*x$ of a linear system ($h$ the impulse response) one often transforms, multiplies or divides, and transforms back.

formulas.note: 卷积的定义：翻转、平移、相乘、积分；$\tau$ 是哑变量，结果只与平移量 $t$ 有关。
formulas.noteEn: Definition: flip, shift, multiply, integrate; $\tau$ is a dummy variable and only the shift $t$ survives.

formulas.note: 交换律、结合律、分配律；卷积因此是一种双线性、结合、交换的运算。
formulas.noteEn: Commutative, associative and distributive laws; convolution is a bilinear, associative, commutative operation.

formulas.note: 卷积定理：时域卷积对应频域（或 $s$ 域）相乘，是信号处理与解微分方程的核心工具。
formulas.noteEn: Convolution theorem: convolution in time becomes multiplication in frequency (or in the $s$-domain) — the key tool of signal processing.

formulas.note: 求导可以落在任意一个因子上（在适当可微与衰减条件下）。
formulas.noteEn: Differentiation may be placed on either factor, under suitable differentiability and decay assumptions.

formulas.note: 宽 1 的矩形脉冲自卷积得到三角形：支撑变宽为 2，形状变光滑。
formulas.noteEn: A unit rectangular pulse convolved with itself gives a triangle: the support doubles in width and the shape becomes smoother.

expression.note: 把 g 翻转后平移 t 再与 f 相乘积分；卷积与傅里叶变换满足 F[f∗g] = F[f]·F[g]。
expression.noteEn: Flip $g$, shift it by $t$, multiply by $f$ and integrate; convolution satisfies $\mathcal{F}[f*g]=F\cdot G$.

properties: 交换律、结合律、分配律一应俱全，再配上线性的数乘，卷积是双线性运算。
支撑集相加：若 $f$ 的支撑在 $[a,b]$、$g$ 的支撑在 $[c,d]$，则 $f*g$ 的支撑在 $[a+c,b+d]$（宽度相加）。
平滑效果：与光滑核卷积使函数变光滑（矩形脉冲自卷积得连续的三角形）；与宽度趋于 0 的窄脉冲卷积近似于平移。
求导可分配到任一因子：$(f*g)'=f'*g=f*g'$，这条性质让卷积能直接代入微分方程。
卷积定理：$\mathcal{F}[f*g]=F(\omega)G(\omega)$，把卷积化为乘法；反过来时域乘积对应频域卷积 $\frac{1}{2\pi}(F*G)$。
propertiesEn: Commutativity, associativity and distributivity hold, so together with bilinearity convolution turns suitable function spaces into a commutative algebra.
Supports add: if $f$ is supported on $[a,b]$ and $g$ on $[c,d]$, then $f*g$ is supported on $[a+c,b+d]$ — widths add.

Smoothing: convolving with a smooth kernel makes a function smoother (a rectangular pulse convolved with itself is a continuous triangle); convolving with a very narrow pulse is approximately a shift.
Differentiation can be moved to either factor: $(f*g)'=f'*g=f*g'$, which is what makes convolution usable in differential equations.
Convolution theorem: $\mathcal{F}[f*g]=F(\omega)G(\omega)$ turns convolution into multiplication; dually, a product in time becomes $\frac{1}{2\pi}(F*G)$ in frequency.

plot.title: 卷积：宽 1 与宽 2 的矩形脉冲卷积得到梯形（宽度 3）

examples.solution:
由定义，$(f*g)(t)=\int_0^1g(t-\tau)\,d\tau$（$f(\tau)=1$ 仅当 $\tau\in[0,1]$）。被积函数 $g(t-\tau)$ 不为零当且仅当 $0\le t-\tau\le2$，即 $t-2\le\tau\le t$。取两者的交集：

当 $t<0$ 或 $t>3$ 时交集为空，$(f*g)(t)=0$；当 $0\le t\le1$ 时交集为 $[0,t]$，长度 $t$；当 $1\le t\le2$ 时交集为 $[0,1]$，长度 $1$；当 $2\le t\le3$ 时交集为 $[t-2,1]$，长度 $3-t$。于是

$$(f*g)(t)=\begin{cases}t,&0\le t\le1,\\1,&1\le t\le2,\\3-t,&2\le t\le3,\\0,&\text{其他}.\end{cases}$$

即「先升、再平、后降」的梯形：在 $t=1$ 处升到最大值 1，支撑区间为 $[0,3]$，长度恰好是两段脉冲宽度之和 $1+2=3$。

examples.problem: 设 $p(t)=1$（$|t|\le\frac12$）、其余为 0，用卷积定理解释「两个矩形脉冲的卷积得到三角脉冲」，并求其傅里叶变换。
examples.solution:
先算 $p*p$：

$$(p*p)(t)=\int_{-1/2}^{1/2}p(t-\tau)\,d\tau,$$

它是区间 $\left[-\frac12,\frac12\right]$ 与 $\left[t-\frac12,t+\frac12\right]$ 的重叠长度。当 $|t|\le1$ 时该长度为 $1-|t|$，当 $|t|>1$ 时为 0，即底宽 2、高 1 的三角形。

再求变换：$P(\omega)=\int_{-1/2}^{1/2}e^{-i\omega t}\,dt=\frac{2\sin(\omega/2)}{\omega}$，由卷积定理

$$\mathcal{F}[p*p](\omega)=P(\omega)^2=\left(\frac{2\sin(\omega/2)}{\omega}\right)^2=\frac{4\sin^2(\omega/2)}{\omega^2}.$$

时域的「三角形」对应频域的「sinc 平方」，这正是照相机、通信系统中常用的平滑窗函数的频谱形状。

title: 傅里叶变换
summary: 把非周期函数分解为连续频率的复指数叠加；采用 F(ω)=∫f(t)e^{−iωt}dt 与 f(t)=(1/2π)∫F(ω)e^{iωt}dω 的约定，矩形脉冲的频谱是 sinc 型函数，高斯的频谱仍是高斯。
summaryEn: Decomposes a non-periodic function into a continuum of complex exponentials; under the convention F(ω)=∫f(t)e^{−iωt}dt with f(t)=(1/2π)∫F(ω)e^{iωt}dω, a rectangular pulse has a sinc-type spectrum and a Gaussian transforms to a Gaussian.
definition:
傅里叶变换把函数从「时域」搬到「频域」。本卡片采用如下**约定**（不同教材的常数因子不同，使用前务必统一）：

$$F(\omega)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(t)e^{-i\omega t}\,dt,\qquad f(t)=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}F(\omega)e^{i\omega t}\,d\omega.$$

$F(\omega)$ 称为 $f$ 的**频谱**，$|F(\omega)|$ 是幅频，$\arg F(\omega)$ 是相频。注意逆变换带着 $\frac{1}{2\pi}$ 因子，而正变换不带。

它是傅里叶级数的连续版本：把周期为 $T$ 的函数展开为频率 $\omega_n=n\omega_0$（$\omega_0=\frac{2\pi}{T}$）的复指数之和；当 $T\to\infty$，离散频率越来越密，级数求和自然地过渡为对 $\omega$ 的积分，而系数化为频谱 $F(\omega)$。所以非周期信号可以看成「周期无限长」的周期信号。

只要 $f$ 绝对可积（$\int|f(t)|dt<\infty$）且分段光滑，变换积分绝对收敛，逆变换在 $f$ 的连续点处成立、在跳跃点给出左右极限的平均值（狄利克雷型条件）。频谱一般是复值的；实信号满足共轭对称 $F(-\omega)=\overline{F(\omega)}$，于是 $|F|$ 是偶函数、相频是奇函数，画图时通常只画 $\omega\ge0$ 的部分。

最简单的例子：宽 $T$、中心在原点的矩形脉冲，其频谱为 $\frac{2\sin(\omega T/2)}{\omega}$——中心峰值加上无穷多个零点（$\omega=\frac{2k\pi}{T}$，$k\ne0$）的振荡函数，即 sinc 型函数；而高斯函数的频谱仍是高斯函数。帕塞瓦尔等式 $\int|f|^2dt=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int|F|^2d\omega$ 则说明变换前后「能量」守恒。
definitionEn:
The Fourier transform moves a function from the time domain to the frequency domain. This card uses the following **convention** (textbooks differ in the constant factors, so fix one convention first):

$$F(\omega)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(t)e^{-i\omega t}\,dt,\qquad f(t)=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}F(\omega)e^{i\omega t}\,d\omega.$$

$F(\omega)$ is called the **spectrum** of $f$, with $|F(\omega)|$ the amplitude spectrum and $\arg F(\omega)$ the phase spectrum. Note that the inverse transform carries the factor $\frac{1}{2\pi}$ while the forward transform does not.

The transform is the continuous version of a Fourier series: a $T$-periodic function is expanded in exponentials at the discrete frequencies $\omega_n=n\omega_0$ with $\omega_0=\frac{2\pi}{T}$; letting $T\to\infty$ makes the frequencies denser and denser until the sum passes into an integral over $\omega$, while the coefficients become the spectrum $F(\omega)$. A non-periodic signal is thus a periodic signal of infinite period.

If $f$ is absolutely integrable ($\int|f(t)|dt<\infty$) and piecewise smooth, the transform converges absolutely, the inversion formula holds at points of continuity, and at a jump it returns the average of the one-sided limits (Dirichlet-type conditions). The spectrum is generally complex; for a real signal it is conjugate symmetric, $F(-\omega)=\overline{F(\omega)}$, so $|F|$ is even and the phase is odd, and one usually plots only $\omega\ge0$.

Simplest examples: a rectangular pulse of width $T$ centred at the origin has spectrum $\frac{2\sin(\omega T/2)}{\omega}$ — a central peak together with infinitely many zeros at $\omega=\frac{2k\pi}{T}$ ($k\ne0$), i.e. a sinc-type function; and a Gaussian transforms to a Gaussian. Parseval's identity $\int|f|^2dt=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int|F|^2d\omega$ expresses conservation of energy.

formulas.note: 傅里叶变换（本卡片约定：正变换不带常数因子，核为 $e^{-i\omega t}$）。
formulas.noteEn: The forward transform (this card's convention: no constant factor, kernel $e^{-i\omega t}$).

formulas.note: 逆变换：把各频率分量按频谱加权后叠加回时域，注意 $\frac{1}{2\pi}$ 因子。
formulas.noteEn: Inverse transform: recombine the frequency components, with the factor $\frac{1}{2\pi}$.

formulas.note: 矩形脉冲的频谱是 sinc 型函数：中心峰值 $T$（即 $\omega\to0$ 的极限），零点等间距分布。
formulas.noteEn: The spectrum of a rectangular pulse is a sinc-type function: central peak $T$ (the limit as $\omega\to0$) with equally spaced zeros.

formulas.note: 高斯函数的变换仍是高斯函数：最窄的高斯变换后最宽，二者互相制约。
formulas.noteEn: A Gaussian transforms to a Gaussian: the narrower the original, the wider the transform.

formulas.note: 双边指数函数的频谱是洛伦兹型；与矩形脉冲不同，它处处光滑、无振荡零点。
formulas.noteEn: The two-sided exponential has a Lorentzian spectrum; unlike the rectangular pulse it is smooth with no oscillatory zeros.

expression.note: 正变换不带常数因子、逆变换带 1/(2π)，这是本卡片统一的约定。
expression.noteEn: No constant in the forward transform, a factor 1/(2π) in the inverse — the convention used throughout this card.

properties: 约定必须统一：本卡片用 $e^{-i\omega t}$ 与逆变换的 $\frac{1}{2\pi}$ 因子；若换成对称约定（正逆变换各乘 $1/\sqrt{2\pi}$），各条性质中的常数会随之改变。
频谱 $F(\omega)$ 一般是复值函数；实信号满足共轭对称 $F(-\omega)=\overline{F(\omega)}$，幅频为偶函数、相频为奇函数。
绝对可积且分段光滑的函数可以反演：连续点处复原为 $f(t)$，跳跃点处给出左右极限的平均值。
帕塞瓦尔等式 $\int|f|^2dt=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int|F|^2d\omega$：变换保持能量，$\frac{1}{2\pi}$ 因子来自本卡片的约定。
卷积定理 $\mathcal{F}[f*g]=F\cdot G$ 把时域卷积化为频域乘法，是滤波器设计与求解微分方程的原理。
propertiesEn: Fix the convention: this card uses $e^{-i\omega t}$ with the factor $\frac{1}{2\pi}$ in the inverse transform; the symmetric convention (both directions with $1/\sqrt{2\pi}$) changes the constants throughout.
The spectrum $F(\omega)$ is generally complex; for a real signal $F(-\omega)=\overline{F(\omega)}$, so the amplitude spectrum is even and the phase spectrum odd.
An absolutely integrable, piecewise smooth function can be recovered: $f(t)$ at continuity points, the average of one-sided limits at jumps.
Parseval's identity, $\int|f|^2dt=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int|F|^2d\omega$, says energy is preserved — with the factor $\frac{1}{2\pi}$ of this convention.
The convolution theorem $\mathcal{F}[f*g]=F\cdot G$ turns time-domain convolution into frequency-domain multiplication, the basis of filter design and ODE solving.

plot.title: 矩形脉冲（|t| ≤ 1）的频谱：F(ω) = 2 sin ω / ω（sinc 型）

examples.problem: 求矩形脉冲 $p(t)=1$（$|t|\le1$）、$p(t)=0$（$|t|>1$）的傅里叶变换，并求 $\omega\to0$ 时的极限。
examples.solution:
按定义

$$F(\omega)=\int_{-1}^{1}e^{-i\omega t}\,dt=\left[\frac{e^{-i\omega t}}{-i\omega}\right]_{-1}^{1}=\frac{e^{-i\omega}-e^{i\omega}}{-i\omega}=\frac{2\sin\omega}{\omega}\quad(\omega\ne0).$$

当 $\omega\to0$ 时 $\frac{2\sin\omega}{\omega}\to2$，而 $F(0)=\int_{-1}^{1}dt=2$，两者一致；这正对应脉冲的面积。频谱在 $\omega=k\pi$（$k=\pm1,\pm2,\dots$）处为零，取值在正负之间振荡衰减。

把积分拆成两段并合并指数：

$$F(\omega)=\int_{-\infty}^{0}e^{at}e^{-i\omega t}\,dt+\int_{0}^{\infty}e^{-at}e^{-i\omega t}\,dt=\int_{-\infty}^{0}e^{(a-i\omega)t}dt+\int_{0}^{\infty}e^{-(a+i\omega)t}dt.$$

两段积分都绝对收敛，直接计算：

$$F(\omega)=\frac{1}{a-i\omega}+\frac{1}{a+i\omega}=\frac{(a+i\omega)+(a-i\omega)}{a^2+\omega^2}=\frac{2a}{a^2+\omega^2}.$$

这是洛伦兹型谱：峰值 $\frac{2}{a}$ 在 $\omega=0$，且当 $|\omega|\to\infty$ 时按 $\frac{1}{\omega^2}$ 衰减（处处为正、无振荡零点）。

title: 傅里叶变换的性质
summary: 线性、时移、频移、缩放、微分、卷积定理与帕塞瓦尔等式——这些性质把时域中的运算翻译成频域中的代数运算，是傅里叶方法解题的骨架。
summaryEn: Linearity, time and frequency shifts, scaling, differentiation, the convolution theorem and Parseval's identity translate operations in the time domain into algebraic operations in frequency — the backbone of the Fourier method.
definition:
本卡片沿用约定 $F(\omega)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(t)e^{-i\omega t}\,dt$ 与 $f(t)=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int F(\omega)e^{i\omega t}d\omega$（记 $\mathcal{F}[f]=F$、$\mathcal{F}[g]=G$）。所有性质都依赖这个约定：换约定时，时移、微分公式中的因子会变号或挪位置。最基本的一条是**线性**：

$$\mathcal{F}[af+bg]=a\mathcal{F}[f]+b\mathcal{F}[g].$$

它在下面每一条性质中都会被用到。

**时移与频移。** 把信号延迟 $t_0$，频谱只是多乘一个相位因子，幅度保持不变：$\mathcal{F}[f(t-t_0)]=e^{-i\omega t_0}F(\omega)$；反过来，用 $e^{i\omega_0 t}$ 调制信号会把频谱整体右移：$\mathcal{F}[e^{i\omega_0t}f(t)]=F(\omega-\omega_0)$。两条公式互为「对偶」，是调幅通信与移相器的数学语言。**缩放**：$\mathcal{F}[f(at)]=\frac{1}{|a|}F\!\left(\frac{\omega}{a}\right)$——时域压缩，频域展宽。

**微分。** $\mathcal{F}[f^{(n)}(t)]=(i\omega)^nF(\omega)$（要求边界项消失），时域求导变成频域乘以 $i\omega$，这正是傅里叶方法能把常微分方程化为代数方程的根据；对偶地，时域乘以 $t$ 对应频域求导：$\mathcal{F}[t\,f(t)]=i\frac{dF}{d\omega}(\omega)$。

**卷积定理与帕塞瓦尔等式。** 时域卷积对应频域相乘：$\mathcal{F}[f*g]=F(\omega)G(\omega)$；反过来时域相乘对应频域卷积：$\mathcal{F}[f\,g]=\frac{1}{2\pi}(F*G)(\omega)$。帕塞瓦尔等式 $\int|f|^2dt=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int|F|^2d\omega$ 说明变换保持能量，其中的 $\frac{1}{2\pi}$ 因子来自本卡片的约定。
definitionEn:
This card keeps the convention $F(\omega)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}f(t)e^{-i\omega t}dt$ with $f(t)=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int F(\omega)e^{i\omega t}d\omega$ (write $\mathcal{F}[f]=F$, $\mathcal{F}[g]=G$). Every property depends on it: under another convention the factors in the shift and differentiation rules move or change sign. The most basic rule is **linearity**:

$$\mathcal{F}[af+bg]=a\mathcal{F}[f]+b\mathcal{F}[g].$$

It will be used in every property below.

**Time and frequency shifts.** Delaying a signal by $t_0$ merely multiplies its spectrum by a phase factor and leaves the magnitude unchanged: $\mathcal{F}[f(t-t_0)]=e^{-i\omega t_0}F(\omega)$. Conversely, modulating with $e^{i\omega_0t}$ shifts the spectrum: $\mathcal{F}[e^{i\omega_0t}f(t)]=F(\omega-\omega_0)$. The two formulas are dual, and they are the language of amplitude modulation and phase shifters. **Scaling:** $\mathcal{F}[f(at)]=\frac{1}{|a|}F\!\left(\frac{\omega}{a}\right)$ — compress in time, stretch in frequency.

**Differentiation.** $\mathcal{F}[f^{(n)}(t)]=(i\omega)^nF(\omega)$ (assuming the boundary terms vanish): differentiation in time becomes multiplication by $i\omega$ in frequency, which is exactly why the Fourier method turns ODEs into algebraic equations. Dually, multiplication by $t$ becomes differentiation in frequency, $\mathcal{F}[t\,f(t)]=i\frac{dF}{d\omega}(\omega)$.

**Convolution theorem and Parseval's identity.** Convolution in time is multiplication in frequency: $\mathcal{F}[f*g]=F(\omega)G(\omega)$. Dually, a product in time becomes convolution in frequency: $\mathcal{F}[f\,g]=\frac{1}{2\pi}(F*G)(\omega)$. Parseval's identity $\int|f|^2dt=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int|F|^2d\omega$ says energy is preserved, the factor $\frac{1}{2\pi}$ again coming from this card's convention.

formulas.note: 线性：变换是线性算子，叠加原理成立。
formulas.noteEn: Linearity: the transform is a linear operator, so superposition holds.

formulas.note: 时移只改变相位；频移把频谱整体平移；缩放使时域压缩、频域展宽。
formulas.noteEn: A time shift only changes the phase; a frequency shift translates the spectrum; scaling compresses one domain and stretches the other.

formulas.note: 时域求导 $\leftrightarrow$ 频域乘 $i\omega$；时域乘 $t$ $\leftrightarrow$ 频域求导。
formulas.noteEn: Differentiation in time $\leftrightarrow$ multiplication by $i\omega$ in frequency; multiplication by $t$ in time $\leftrightarrow$ differentiation in frequency.

formulas.note: 卷积定理及其对偶形式：时域卷积 $\leftrightarrow$ 频域相乘，时域相乘 $\leftrightarrow$ 频域卷积。
formulas.noteEn: The convolution theorem and its dual: convolution in time $\leftrightarrow$ multiplication in frequency, and vice versa up to $\frac{1}{2\pi}$.

formulas.note: 帕塞瓦尔等式：能量守恒，$|F(\omega)|^2$ 称为能量谱密度。
formulas.noteEn: Parseval's identity: conservation of energy, with $|F(\omega)|^2$ the energy spectral density.

expression.text: F[f(t − t₀)] = e^(−iωt₀) F(ω)，F[e^(iω₀t) f(t)] = F(ω − ω₀)
expression.note: 时移只改变相位（幅度谱不变）；频移把频谱整体平移，二者互为对偶。
expression.noteEn: A time shift changes only the phase (the amplitude spectrum is untouched); a frequency shift translates the spectrum — the two are dual.

properties: 线性是一切性质的起点：变换把线性组合变成线性组合，因此可以把复杂信号拆成简单分量分别处理。
时移只改变相位（$|F|$ 不变），对应「延迟不改变各频率成分的强弱」；频移则整体平移频谱，对偶成立。
微分性质 $\mathcal{F}[f^{(n)}]=(i\omega)^nF$ 把常微分方程化为代数方程，是傅里叶方法的核心；对偶形式 $\mathcal{F}[tf]=iF'(\omega)$ 同样常用。
缩放性质 $\mathcal{F}[f(at)]=\frac{1}{|a|}F(\omega/a)$：时域越集中，频域越展开，这是不确定性原理的雏形。
卷积定理与帕塞瓦尔等式：$\mathcal{F}[f*g]=FG$、$\int|f|^2=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int|F|^2$；后者说明能量在变换前后守恒（注意约定中的 $\frac{1}{2\pi}$）。
propertiesEn: Linearity starts everything: a linear combination of signals transforms into the same combination of transforms, so complicated signals split into simple pieces.
A time shift changes only the phase ($|F|$ is unchanged) — delay does not alter how strong each frequency component is; a frequency shift translates the spectrum, dually.
The differentiation rule $\mathcal{F}[f^{(n)}]=(i\omega)^nF$ converts ODEs into algebraic equations, the heart of the Fourier method; its dual $\mathcal{F}[tf]=iF'(\omega)$ is equally useful.
Scaling, $\mathcal{F}[f(at)]=\frac{1}{|a|}F(\omega/a)$: concentration in one domain means spreading in the other — the germ of the uncertainty principle.
Convolution theorem and Parseval: $\mathcal{F}[f*g]=FG$ and $\int|f|^2=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int|F|^2$; energy is preserved (mind the $\frac{1}{2\pi}$ of this convention).

plot.title: 高斯函数的傅里叶变换仍是高斯：e^(−t²) ↔ √π e^(−ω²/4)

examples.solution:
把余弦写成复指数：$\cos 3t=\frac{e^{3it}+e^{-3it}}{2}$，则 $e^{-t^2/2}\cos 3t=\frac12\left(e^{3it}e^{-t^2/2}+e^{-3it}e^{-t^2/2}\right)$。

由线性与频移性质（$\omega_0=\pm3$）：

$$\mathcal{F}\left[e^{-t^2/2}\cos3t\right](\omega)=\frac12\left[\sqrt{2\pi}e^{-(\omega-3)^2/2}+\sqrt{2\pi}e^{-(\omega+3)^2/2}\right].$$

即单个高斯峰裂成了中心在 $\omega=\pm3$ 的两个高斯峰——这正是「调制使频谱搬移」的直观图像。

取 $f(t)=\frac{\sin t}{t}$。由矩形脉冲的频谱（对偶性）可得 $\mathcal{F}[f](\omega)=\pi$（$|\omega|<1$），$=0$（$|\omega|>1$）：矩形脉冲 $p(t)=1$（$|t|\le1$）的变换是 $\frac{2\sin\omega}{\omega}$，再由对偶关系 $\mathcal F[F(t)]=2\pi f(-\omega)$ 即可得到该结果。

由帕塞瓦尔等式

$$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{\sin^2t}{t^2}\,dt=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}|f(t)|^2dt=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}|F(\omega)|^2d\omega=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-1}^{1}\pi^2d\omega=\frac{1}{2\pi}\cdot2\pi^2=\pi.$$

所以 $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{\sin^2t}{t^2}dt=\pi$，这也是光学与信号处理中著名的积分。
